newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein market closed on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein market closed on Friday.

text.p: Indonesia's palm olein and crude palm oil markets were closed on Friday due to the Moslem Eid al-Adha celebration. Trading resumes on Monday.
Traders said on Thursday prices were mostly stable in late trading as buying interest waning ahead of the holiday.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,246.61 rupiah/kg exBelawan at a tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Wednesday.
